test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My house is ___ the bank and the post office.
solution:
The correct answer is '**between**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**between**" is used when referring to two specific entities, here being "**the bank**" and "**the post office**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"My house is **between**__ the bank and the post office."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "among"** refers to being part of a group or surrounded by multiple entities, which doesn’t apply here.
 
• **Option 2: "across"** indicates being on the other side, which is not the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 3: "beside"** means being next to a single entity, not in between two.
